messages.subject: Please route to Talent Acquisition | Mining, sustainability and corporate affairs executive
messages.body:
Dear Orica People Services Global Hub,

I appreciate that this mailbox supports Orica's people processes. I am writing because an earlier executive introduction to an Orica corporate contact was rejected by my mail provider before delivery. I would be grateful if you would route this note and attached CV to the appropriate Talent Acquisition leader, and where appropriate to the office of Mr. Germán Morales, President, Australia Pacific and Sustainability.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My 12+ years across multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations have built a leadership profile spanning ESG, government and regulatory relations, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory.

For Orica, I would bring direct operator-side insight into the issues affecting mining-services growth and reputation. My recent work includes government and regulator engagement across a major gold operation, community and social-performance governance, stakeholder support around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, and carbon-data readiness using physical operating records. I understand how sustainability commitments succeed when they are connected to operating accountability, evidence and stakeholder confidence.

I am interested in senior international mandates across Sustainability, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Stakeholder Strategy, Strategic Partnerships, Country Leadership or related mining-sector roles. I am open to Australia Pacific, Latin America, EMEA and other international markets, with a 30-day notice period.

My attached CV is tailored specifically to Orica. I would value a confidential discussion with the relevant senior talent or business leader.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
